review.notes: All 58 physical pages compared token-by-token against the OCR markdown (case/punctuation-normalized), full-document code-fence audit (balanced), and heading audit against the printed outline. Pages 12, 19, 23, 24, 30, 33, 34 and 37 were additionally rendered (110-120 dpi full pages, 300 dpi crops) to visually verify every patch. Four supplementary outline bullets on printed pages 23-24 and one bold 'Answer: 397' line inside the printed Table S.8 (page 34) were wrongly promoted to markdown headings; Table S.11's candidate-B SMILES was OCR-misread c1->cl with a dropped 'c' in six occurrences; two Table S.5 task descriptions carry the print's own misspellings ('lipohilicity', 'distributon') that OCR had silently corrected; reference 28 prints 'Rodriques' but OCR wrote 'Rodrigues'; the Table S.8 binding-affinity drug SMILES prints 'Nc3ccccc3' (five ring carbons) but OCR wrote six. The amino-acid wrap 'KDGKLVV-/ECVMNN...' was re-verified at 300 dpi and matches the OCR (no patch). Figure-internal text (Figure 6 BBB chat transcript on page 12, 'Geneneralist' axis-label typo on pages 7/41, Figure S.4 MMLU-subject axis labels on page 49, dialogue screenshots on pages 50-52) is shown by embedded figures and was left unchanged; the rotated arXiv sidebar stamp on page 1 was not treated as droppage.
